_comment: Ground truth from Factorio 2.1.20 (build 87512, linux64, headless), read out of the running game with gdb rather than through Lua: every call the CHUNK-GRID multioctave path made to the grid basis_noise kernel Noise::noise(float, float, unsigned int, unsigned int, float, float, float, NoiseScratch&, float*), for three multioctave_noise expressions and one offset basis_noise routed to Nauvis's elevation, moisture, aux and temperature during a --create. Per chunk (world origin x, y): `octaves`, each octave's kernel arguments as the game passed them (origin x0, y0, step, and outputScale = that octave's amplitude; the input scale is the case's), and `values`, the shared buffer after the last octave, 1,024 floats, row-major, row r and column i being world tile (x + i, y + r). Octaves were chained by buffer content, not by a model. Cross-checked: 2.0.77 (build 84539, linux64, headless) returned bit-identical values. Captured by scripts/probes/multioctave-grid (#451). Graded by crates/fmw-noise/src/fixtures.rs.
